title: Solid Angle
text:
A solid angle(Omega) is a 3-dimensional version of a standard 2-dimensional plane angle. It measures how large an object appears from a specific point (called the apex), or how much of an observer's field of view that object covers.

Core Definition and Formula[edit]

The Formula: \(\Omega = \frac{A}{r^2}\)• \(A\) • \(A\) is the surface area of the projection on a sphere of radius \(r\). • \(r\) is the radius of that sphere. Units: Measured in steradians (symbol: sr), which are the 3D equivalent of radians
